_doc: Bot navigation mesh (AI_SPEC 3, src/nav.*). Recast/Detour, baked from the physics world per 32 m tile; dirty tiles (+1 tile border) rebuild on background threads. The agent matches the player capsule (radius 0.3 m, src/physics.h): AI_SPEC says about 0.35 m and to match the capsule. cell_m must divide tile_m. Links: drop (one way) 0.5-3 m, mantle (two way) 0.5-1.6 m, vault obstacles up to 1.1 m high and 0.6 m thick, jump gaps up to 1.5 m; anything higher (anti-tank ditch faces, quarry faces) gets no link. cost_m: extra path cost per traversal (metres of jogging).
